# Put tests in the existing suite for the area you changed

Add tests to the suite that already covers the area — e.g. `test/cli/dts` for type tests, `test/ui` for the UI, `test/coverage-test` for coverage, `test/core/diff.test.ts` for diffs — and reuse its helpers. Run integration tests through a fixture or `runInlineTests`.
